group_assessment.weighting: Two adult women with Dravet syndrome (SCN1A; one variant of uncertain significance) with parkinsonism around 30 years of age, DAT SPECT normal in both, CSF HVA and 5-HIAA below the cited reference interval in both. n = 2, adults, no CSF from Dravet patients without parkinsonism, polypharmacy. The observation (low CSF metabolites in two adults) is firm as reported; the interpretation (reduced dopamine synthesis causes the parkinsonism) is the authors' hypothesis. Not a neonatal or WWOX system.

entries.proposition: Two adult women with Dravet syndrome are described, with SCN1A variants, one classified as of uncertain significance.
entries.snippet: this variant was classified as having uncertain significance (PM2, PM5, and PP3)

entries.proposition: Both had normal striatal DAT SPECT binding.
entries.snippet: DAT SPECT also showed no decrease in the signal intensity in the striatum (Figure 1D).

entries.proposition: CSF HVA and 5-HIAA were below the reference intervals in both cases (Table 2).
5-HIAA is also low in both cases against the cited interval.
The authors state that CSF monoamine metabolite levels can be lowered secondarily by epilepsy and convulsions and by collection conditions.
entries.snippet: can be reduced secondarily because of epilepsy, convulsions, and other factors

entries.proposition: The authors state the lack of CSF data from Dravet patients without parkinsonism is a limitation.
entries.snippet: The lack of CSF data in patients with DS who do not have parkinsonism is an important limitation of our study.

entries.proposition: Case 2 stayed on valproate through the work-up, so her CSF values were obtained on an antiseizure drug.
entries.snippet: She was taking VPA, but we did not discontinue it because she had been taking it for many years

entries.proposition: Only one earlier report measured CSF monoamine metabolites in Dravet parkinsonism and it gave no measured values.
entries.snippet: this is the only report in which CSF monoamine metabolites were measured in such patients, and the actual measured values were not reported

entries.proposition: Case 1 improved on levodopa-carbidopa; Case 2 was started on a low dose and effect was still being evaluated.
entries.snippet: We initiated treatment with a low dose of levodopa and carbidopa combination and are evaluating its effectiveness (Table 1).

entries.proposition: The authors' conclusion is that decreased dopamine synthesis may be present in at least some patients with Dravet syndrome.
entries.snippet: we conclude that a decrease in dopamine synthesis may be present at least in some patients with DS
